explanation: BENCHMARK DISCREPANCY EXPLANATION: The official Step 24 holdout R11 benchmark (70.67% accuracy, 64.26% Macro F1) is fully reproduced by loading the subject-specific model artifacts from models/step24/selected_model/Sxxx/. In contrast, the 63.00% / 55.80% result reported in Step 29 and Step 30 was produced because Step 29/30 evaluated a sub-sampled global model fit on partial calibration splits (val_tr_X) rather than the pre-trained subject-specific models, and applied confidence-layer abstention filtering. Level 1 raw model evaluation of Step 24 artifacts confirms the official champion benchmark.
